name: Your product here
tagline: Reach Claude users at the exact moment they're picking tools.
_help: Edit only this file to change sponsors. To run a real sponsor: set demo:false and fill name/tagline/url (logo = image URL, optional). bar: ticker fixed to the bottom of every page (sideways scroll, pauses on hover/focus, visitor can hide it). card: one card after the top 5 results on the home page; keywords (optional) limit the card to prompts containing one of them. demo:true labels both as 'Example sponsor' and should point url at /sponsor/. active:false hides the bar and shows a plain house card linking to /sponsor/.
